thread:
Sophie: Quick async — gateway / routing / auth / rate-limits check-in.
Sophie: What I did: merged edge-proxy 429 backoff fix, added route_id tags to metrics, updated docs for per-route ratepolicy schema.
Sophie: Blockers: still seeing occasional p95 spikes when batch_size=32 (mainly on embeddings path), need infra input on pod scheduling / cpu throttling.
Sophie: Today: iterate on canary rollout for per-route ratepolicies, open PR for 429 test harness, ping @Matt for CR.

Matt: Saw the merge, nice. Can you drop the minimal config you'll canary with? Also open a small PR to add the repro to our load-test harness so CI covers it.

Sophie: config snippet I'm starting with:
```
rate_policy:
  - route: "/api/v1/chat"
    limit: 120/s
    burst: 240
    action: 429
```

Devon: FYI I noticed a flakey failure in the auth integration tests after the merge — middleware not reading the new jwt-rotated header. Might be a timing window.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: gw-canary-2301 -> 10% traffic (region: us-west-2).

Oliver: @Sophie can you paste the p95 histogram? If it's cold-start related we should correlate with pod restarts. Link to grafana: https://grafana.internal/gw/d/overview/p95

Sophie: posted p95 dump to #eng-sre — pattern shows spikes aligned with cold-starts on the embeddings subpath, not sustained.

Sara: Quick question: for routes that get 429'd, do we want a deterministic fallback to a cheaper model pool or return immediate 429? Fallback reduces token cost but changes responses.

Matt: I'd prefer deterministic fallback to a compatible quantized variant (v1.1-quant) with a regression test to catch semantic regressions. Avoid silent behavior changes.

Devon: I'm blocked on jwt rotation tests — need a test keypair that simulates a rotation window. @Ken can you provision?

Ken: Yep, handing over a short-lived rotation keypair in ~20m to the test account. Also bumping staging gateway replicas +2 to see if p95 stabilizes.

Sophie: Great — next actions for me: 1) open PR for 429 test harness (w/ load-test case), 2) PR for canary rollout config (10->50% ramp), 3) telemetry PR adding route_id and batch_size tags. Will ping reviewers when ready.

Matt: Sounds good. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Devon: I'll follow up on the auth test and either fix or rollback depending on risk.

Ken: ping me if you need the keypair earlier.

Sophie: will do — closing this async thread, will update with PR links shortly.
